title: Longest Subarray with Bounded Difference
prompt:
Implement `longest_bounded_subarray(nums, limit) -> int`. Return the maximum length of a contiguous nonempty subarray whose maximum minus minimum is at most `limit`. `nums` contains integers; `limit` is a nonnegative integer. Return `0` for an empty input. Do not mutate `nums`. Target `O(n)` time using monotonic deques and `O(n)` auxiliary space.

Practice reconstruction: the return value is a length, and empty input is explicitly defined. Under the nonnegative-limit contract, every singleton is valid; the source's “all-invalid single values” case cannot occur.
